---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement for players, organizers or operators
---

## The situation

Who is this for (player, Tournament organizer, community operator, developer) and what are they
trying to do? What happens today?

## The idea

Describe the change you have in mind. Screenshots or sketches with synthetic data are welcome.

## Alternatives

Other ways you considered, or how you work around it now.

Please keep names, accounts and recordings of real players out of the request.
